note: TEST-ONLY dev service-claim pin. Synthetic Ed25519 keypair generated once with Tink; ONLY the public keyset is stored here. Pendingtest/debug isolated harnesses ONLY. NEVER production custody: deployment requires an independently configured pin history, never this pair.
algorithm: ED25519 (Tink 69-byte framing, same as sender publish signatures)

private_custody: Private half is NOT in this repo. Isolated automated suites keep ephemeral per-test signers. A shared synthetic dev deployment holding the private half (if ever stood up) is root-owned integration scope, out of T185.
